bonuses.leadin: This country’s nueva trova movement was led by Silvio Rodríguez, who composed politically-charged songs such as “Fusil contra fusil.” For 10 points each:

bonuses.leadin: Three of these particles are absorbed by the electroweak gauge bosons in the Higgs mechanism, thus giving the W’s and Z their masses. For 10 points each:

parts: Name this Serbian performance artist who concluded her Rhythm series with a performance where she stood still for six hours and invited audience members to do anything they wanted with a selection of 72 objects.
This German artist, a long-time partner of Abramović, made several innovations in polaroid art while collaborating on and documenting Abramović’s performances.
Ulay and Abramović co-performed one piece where they only did this action using the output of each other. Calm and even rhythms for this action are one of the recommended practices during meditation.

parts: Comstock-inspired censors once arrested actors on the opening night of Waiting For Lefty in what largest city in Massachusetts?

Boston’s censorship laws, and in particular the Watch and Ward Society that supported them, faced an early defeat when this journalist was acquitted for obscenity after selling a copy of The American Mercury. His coverage of Tennessee v. Scopes coined the nickname “monkey trial.”

Mencken was represented by lawyers from this organization that, under the leadership of Roger Nash Baldwin, was also involved in the free speech cases Scopes, Gitlow v. New York, and US v. One Book Called Ulysses.

bonuses.leadin: Despite being an explosives specialist in the Vietnam War, George Hayduke claims to need “an atom bomb” to blow up one of these structures. For 10 points each:

In a novel by this author, the Arizona town of Grace fights back against the Black Mountain Mining Company, who pollute the local river and its drinking water. This author created an Appalachian kid who dreams of seeing the ocean in an adaptation of David Copperfield.

This John Steinbeck novel’s repetition of the line “Danny wants a cup of water” frames the tough drought conditions faced by the Joad family while heading down the “mother road” to California during the Great Depression.

bonuses.leadin: This scientist’s work was chronicled in the unfortunately titled memoir Love at Goon Park. For 10 points each:
parts: Name this scientist who published his findings in a work called “The Nature of Love.” This psychologist used devices like the “rape rack” and the “pit of despair” in unethical experiments.
